about.title: Personal care, right in your neighbourhood
body: Anita Roges Clinic was started by Dr. Anita Roges to give families in Madhanandapuram a general practice that feels personal — the kind of clinic where the doctor already knows your history before you finish describing your symptoms.
From a child's fever to an elderly parent's ongoing blood pressure check-up, every member of the family is seen by the same familiar doctor, in the same welcoming clinic, visit after visit.
Evening hours mean you don't have to choose between work and a doctor's visit, and walk-ins are always accommodated wherever possible.
highlights: One doctor, consistently, across every visit
Morning and evening hours to fit your day

blogPosts.title: Why Having One Doctor Who Knows Your History Actually Matters
blogPosts.excerpt: It's easy to underestimate how much continuity of care changes the quality of your treatment — here's why seeing the same doctor, visit after visit, matters more than it seems.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Anita Roges
content: When you see a different doctor every time you visit a clinic, every appointment starts from zero — a new person hearing your symptoms for the first time, working from a chart instead of a memory.

Continuity of care changes that. When one doctor sees you consistently, they start to notice patterns you might not even mention — a recurring headache that lines up with stress, a blood pressure trend worth watching, a medication that didn't quite agree with you last time.

This matters most for chronic conditions like diabetes and hypertension, where small changes over months are exactly what need tracking. It also matters for something as simple as a child's recurring cold, where a familiar doctor can tell the difference between 'this is normal for them' and 'this is new.'

That's the idea behind how this clinic is run. Every patient, across every visit, is seen by the same doctor — so the care you get keeps building on what came before, instead of starting over each time.
